scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist', 'public', 'build'].forEach(d => fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', d, {recursive: true})); if (fs.existsSync('api')) fs.cpSync('api', 'dist/api', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('backend/dist')) fs.cpSync('backend/dist', 'dist/backend/dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev:all: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
